output.question: What are Amazon's subsidiaries?
output.answer: Amazon.com, Inc.'s latest annual report (Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025, Exhibit 21.1) names nine significant subsidiaries, all 100% owned. They are Amazon.com Services LLC, Amazon.com Sales, Inc., Amazon Data Services, Inc., Amazon Web Services, Inc. and Amazon US Services LLC; A100 ROW, Inc. is also on the list. All six are Delaware entities. The other three are Amazon Technologies, Inc. and Amazon.com NV Investment Holdings LLC, both in Nevada, and Day One Insurance, Inc. in Arizona. Amazon has hundreds of other subsidiaries that SEC rules don't require it to list. Well-known brands it owns, such as Whole Foods, Zappos, Twitch, Ring and MGM, are not on this list, and I did not check their current status for this answer.
output.as_of: 2025-12-31 (fiscal year covered by the 10-K exhibit, filed in 2026)

key_facts.fact: Amazon's FY2025 Form 10-K Exhibit 21.1, 'List of Significant Subsidiaries', names nine entities, each shown as 100% owned.
Delaware: Amazon.com Services LLC, Amazon.com Sales, Inc., Amazon Data Services, Inc., Amazon Web Services, Inc., Amazon US Services LLC, A100 ROW, Inc.
Nevada: Amazon Technologies, Inc. and Amazon.com NV Investment Holdings LLC. Arizona: Day One Insurance, Inc.

passages.quote: AMAZON.COM, INC. LIST OF SIGNIFICANT SUBSIDIARIES

caveats: Exhibit 21.1 lists only 'significant' subsidiaries as SEC rules define them. Amazon has many more subsidiaries worldwide, and they are not disclosed in this list.

Consumer-facing brands Amazon has acquired, such as Whole Foods Market, Zappos, Twitch, Ring, MGM, One Medical and Audible, are not on this exhibit. I did not check them against a primary source for this answer.
The list is as of fiscal year-end 2025. Any acquisitions or restructurings made in 2026 would not show up until the next 10-K.
I did not confirm the exact filing date of the 10-K. The exhibit's EDGAR accession number points to a 2026 filing.
